description: Synthetic backups written by ios-backup-core's backupgen (layer L4 in docs/BACKUP_TEST_CORPUS_PLAN.md). Generated on demand into <cache>/syn/<key>/, each with an expected.json answer key. Items in the 'pr' tier run in every PR's CI once backupgen and the persona are available. 'purpose' says what each persona is for: testpersona checks the generator itself; einstein is the sparse set (Messages and Contacts only, so every other tab must show its empty state).
